verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI provides a natural-language chat interface with codebase context (GEMINI.md, --include-directories, checkpointing) that developers can run in a terminal, including one embedded in an IDE, but the evidence pack shows no dedicated IDE extension/panel—only a CLI tool and a reference to a separate 'Gemini Code Assist' docs page, and community feedback criticizes its codebase navigation and agentic reliability.
